fullPassage:
'Does your father come and see you often?' 'Not often. He doesn't like seeing me because it makes him remember my mother. She died when I was born, so he almost hates me, I think.'
'Why do you say you're going to die?' asked Mary.
'I've always ill. I've nearly died several times, and my back's never been strong. My doctor feels sure that I'm going to die. But he's my father's cousin, and very poor, so he'd like me to die. Then he'd get all the money when my father dies. He gives me medicine and tells me to rest. We had a grand doctor from London once, who told me to go out in the fresh air and try to get well. But I hate fresh air. And another thing, I want, because if I'm angry, I become ill.' May thought she liked this boy, although he seemed so strange. He asked her lots of questions, and she told him all about her life in India.
